batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b Pankaj Singh

batting.name: V Kohli

balls.text: yorker, around leg stump, gets the inside half of the bat, comes back for two as it rolls softly towards deep midwicket
picks the slower ball early, makes room, and lofts him over long-off, good timing, first six of the innings
looks to play the scoop shot, done in by the slower ball, VK rushes up to the striker's end to prevent a bye
length bowling, no great pace, and asking to be hit. Raut makes room and lofts him down the ground, straight
goes for the big heave, slices it wide of mid-off and takes two
Good filed placement. Slower ball, gets the edge on the slog, and the third man is straight to keep them down to one
yorker, gets just a single to long-off
placed well again, wide of long-on, gets a couple
back of a length, dragged from outside off to wide of long-on, and they come back for two
full, following him, hit powerfully to long-on
full and straight, hit straight of long-on, and they come back for two
drilled back at him, on the bump, Kallis can't get his hands down in time
angled into the pads, worked away to square leg for one
Steyn is playing around with them, beats him with the quickness this time, beats his cut shot before the bat comes down
beautiful slower legcutter, 114.7ks, and Voges is beaten this time, through it before it arrives
backs away, Steyn follows him, yorks him, only a single
beats him for the pace again, the slowness this time, through the big heave before it arrives
short and slightly wide, and he beats Raut for the pace, through him before he plays the cut shot
slower ball, opens the face on it for a single
tries a yorker, turns out to be a low full toss, hit to long-on
slower ball, steered to third man for one
better bowling, around off, no room, pushed to long-off for one
full and wide, overpitched, and Voges is the master of picking gaps, drives this along the ground and wide of mid-off - 100 comes up
short and wide, and he has got enough power and placement in the shot to beat the two deep fielders on the off side
short and quick, worked away to deep midwicket for another single
worked away to the on side for a single
short and quick, pulled away to deep square
full, nearly a yorker, digs it out for one
fast, back of a length, pushed back to the bowler
full, pushed to long-off for one
one short bowl too many, sits up and gives him width, and he very nicely punches it square, one of the more difficult shots, and it's square enough of third man
makes a false movement away from the stumps, but VK holds its line around off, pushed to long-on for one
fuller, around off, Voges almost squared up for no reason
is late into the pull again, manages to keep it down as it rolls along towards square leg
fuller, pushes at it, and gets an outside edge fine of third man. When in doubt, edge. The tail funda
another bouncer, and again Raut is too late on this one, 125ks
slower ball, and he gets nothing on that cut shot, hits it limply to cover-point
back of a length, wide outside off, no feet, and he is beaten on the cut, and it passes just inside the wide line
tries the shot again, but this is faster and beats him for pace
nice shot, uses Steyn's pace, opens the face on a short delivery, past third man for four
slower one, runs this down to third man
Joga Bonito! full, slight outswing, pitches middle, takes off, wasted on Yusuf who is stuck on the back foot, expecting a bouncer, and in no position to play this one. Fear psychosis there
full and straight, hit back to Kallis
gets the length and the line back, back of a length, around off, cutting in, pushed to straightish midwicket
More on the off stump this time, pushed back to the bowler
Straying down the pads, kisses the thigh pad, and wide of Uthappa, a specialist keeper would have stopped this one
fuller this time, and pushed wide of midwicket for two
continues with his quick offcutters, back of a length, tucking him up, no room to play this
Pankaj really doesn't have the pace to bounce Yusuf, this one sits up outside off, and he cuts it mercilessly for four, also 1000 IPL runs for him
tries the slower bouncer, it doesn't rise much, and Yusuf adjusts very well, pauses a moment, and then pulls it very well, between the two deep fielders on the on side
slower ball, and Jhunjhunwala has been put out of his misery! Makes room early and doesn't get any bat behind this hit, and Kumble's long arms of the law make it easy at mid-off
again this one doesn't rise, pulled away along the ground for one
this short one doesn't rise up, and Pathan gets a bottom edge onto the pad
and even he bounces Yusuf, 126.5ks, wide of off, beats his attempt at the upper-cut. Ouch, Pankaj Singh, who hardly has any pace, bouncing Yusuf. That has to hurt the batsman
sees him back away too soon, and pushes through a slower ball wide of off
back of a length, pushed past the bowler to one for long-on
fuller ball, Jhunjhun clears the front leg and hits it to sweeper-cover
this one doesn't rise, and is around off, and he late-cuts it to third man, which is fine
oh oh oh, short, into the rib/chest area, Yusuf almost treads onto the stumps while fending, doesn't get bat on it
bouncer right away, not surprising, but it goes down the leg side
pulled straight to square leg! Looks to manufacture a shot, pulling off the front foot, hits low to the right of the only man in the circle on the leg side, and KP takes a sharp catch
Kumble is looking for the lb against Watson, full, fast, straight, Watson's bat comes down late but just in time to push it to long-on for one
even quicker, 96.4ks, Jhunjhun looks to cut, and somehow the bottom edge bounces over the stumps
full and fast, 94.4ks, lands on the crease, digs it out somehow
stays back and cuts this one to sweeper-cover
misreads the length, stays back to a fullish delivery that skids on, but gets the inside half of the bat and comes back for two as the ball finds the gap on the on side
flighted around off, defended
banged in short, Abhishek backs away and plays an ugly pull shot  - beaten for pace and by bounce - and just about clears the mid-on fielder running back
on the middle and leg, again cramping Abhishek for room, and this time he finally goes to the on side and clips it past square-leg..
swing and a miss. in the zone outside off, Abhishek tries to cut it but doesn't connect
yet again shows the tendency to try stay beside the line, yet again Kallis cramps him for room by following him, jabbed out to short cover
again stays beside the line, tries to by moving on the leg stump line and Kallis tucks him up with a length delivery, pushed back down the pitch
length delivery on the middle, he stays adjacent to the line and steers to backward point
fired down the pads, gets a leg-bye to short fine
looks for the pull again, ends up hitting it to long-on again
flighted around off, pushed down to long-off
looks for the pull, but too full and fast for it, and he gets a single down the ground
this one doesn't need a free hit! full and wide, and he has driven it handsomely through the cover
breaks the shackles, slogs him past midwicket, and he has overstepped too
looks to late-cut, but it is too close to him
looks to steer this to third man, gets bottom edge towards keeper
steered to third man for one
beautiful bowling, slower ball, 117ks, moves in after pitching back of a length, beats him
half-volley, outside off, Watson doesn't get the timing on this one, hits it to short cover
fuller, but not driveable, pushed to cover-point, Kohli is alert there
bouncer, 145kph, Watson late in the pull, hits it to mid-on
and the water filter lets one through! This one is hit to the right of Kallis at backward point, and he is late on the dive, but manages to get a hand on it
fuller, straighter, hit limply towards mid-on who is alert on the single
short and wide again, and Watson has missed out, he just can't find a gap in the cover ring. The ball is dirt and the this cover field is a good water filter
fuller, around off, gets an inside edge but Watson calls him through for an easy single
fuller, stops as him as he looks to drive on the up, checks the shot, goes one bounce to short cover
first runs off Pankaj, and this is a poor delivery, short and wide, and Jhunjhun cuts it between backward point and cover point
goes wide of the crease, gets this to nip back in to Watson, who gets a couple off the inside half of the bat
room given this time, steered to third man for the first run in 11 balls
shorter, Jhunjhunwala cuts, but this one doesn't quite come on, hit to straighter cover this time
no room at all, just back of a length, on off, defended to cover
this is slightly fuller, pushed to cover
big effort in the follow through, Jhunjhun looks to pull it, gets the toe end, which is dying on Vinay who dives forward and to his left but doesn't get there
and he has started off with a wicket-maiden, same length, not much room, Watson can't beat the cover ring again
nice punch, but can't pierce the cover ring
slightly fuller, no room, Watto defends again
keeps his length, just short of driving length, and Watson defends

this one goes to hand! Looks to flick it on the up, it's just back of a length, and he gets a huge top edge, and that skies towards midwicket where Pandey takes a calm catch. Poor shot,l looking to drag it from outside off
starts off with one that holds its line from back of a length, gets a thick outside edge that is safe
lovely punch shot, back of a length, but gives him enough room and he sends it crashing past cover
back of a length, around off, defended back

Aravinda gone first ball! Doesn't stay long enough to show what Warne saw in him. Lovely bouncer. Cross seam, aimed at the temple, Paunikar looks to pull, is late into it, gets a faint edge, and Uthappa doesn't drop it
steered away past point for one

another run-out for Rajasthan! Warne is bemused in the dugout. Vinay bowls this short, Ojha plays it straight to backward point. Lumb wants one, Ojha doesn't. It's Lumb's call, but Ojha doesn't budge. And it's an easy run-out at the non-striker's end
nice shot, nothing wrong with the ball, makes room slightly by clearing the front leg, and then squeezes it through the covers
slower ball, 119.6kph, defended towards midwicket
digs it halfway mark, gets it only rib high, and down the leg side - no bounce in the pitch
fuller this time, around off, defended to cover
no bounce in the pitch, looks for the hip-rib area, this one goes thigh-high, and the line is too leg-sidish. Ojha guides it past the keeper for four
makes room, Steyn follows him, manges to get wide of mid-off for one
full, outside off, stays low and beats Lumb's drive, bounces in front of Uthappa
149kph, straight, Ojha is caught on the crease, but the bat comes down just in time
overpitched again, hit back to the bowler
another googly, too full and too straight, and he has flicked it over the infield on the leg side
googly, around off, driven firmly to mid-off
flighted around middle, worked to mid-on for one
steered towards backward point, Steyn dives too early, but recovers, getting back up on one hand and then keeps them down to one
starts off with a flat delivery pushed through, Lumb looks to cut and is beaten
all over! a nice pick-up shot to a back-of-a-length delivery over midwicket
short ball, wide outside off, just inside the wide line, just within acceptable height limit
back of a length, tips and runs
pulled, bottom edge for one
he has ripped the stumps at the non-strikers end out of their groove. Hit very powerfully back. Four runs saved
slog-swept to deep square leg
quicker one on the pads, defended
short ball, it's a shooter, bounces twice before reaching the keeper who is standing up
another flighted delivery, Taylor defends
presses forward and defends
slower ball, short and wide, cut in front of point, four runs
short and wide, beaten on the cut
short ball, pulls, and fins short midwicket. Drags it from wide outside off. Safe catch by Watson
slower ball, hit to mid-on
back of a length, punched away
gets an inside edge as he looks to play it to cover
high full toss, punched through the covers for one
comes forward to defend a full delivery
cut away for one
another flighted delivery on off, defended again
flighted around leg, defended
short ball, looks to cut it, but the ball doesn't turn as much as he expects and hence the bottom edge
wide outside off, driven through the covers

pushed to cover-point, KP wants one, Kohli says no, KP keeps running, Kohli stands his ground. KP is run out, but he gives Kohli a nasty glare, and then stands in the middle, perhaps suggesting he reached the striker's end first. KP has to go, say the replays. Unnecessary blip on Bangalore's night at the very end, slightly unsavoury too
short and wide, and he upper-cuts this one, wide of third man
short ball, pulled away with ease, deep midwicket comes charging in but it bounces in front of him and then over him
back of a length, punched down to long-off for one
back of a length, another tip-and-run
full, yorks him, KP can't get much bat on it
flighted delivery outside off, tips and runs

appeal for stumping as he misses out on that switch hit. Replays shot that while he was stuck on the line for a second, a minute part of his foot slid back over it by the time bails came off. And he has given him out! Third Ump! "You make up your own minds at home. You saw it," says Jeremy Coney on air
pushed down to long-off for one
another lovely shot, down the pitch, close to the ball, and goes straight into the sight screen. Got to admire Ojha's optimism here. "Come on Warney, just one wicket here," he says
again, there's just the flight and no dip, and this time he stylishly he hits this half-volley against the spin, with such power that long-on can't even take three steps to his right
short ball, Uthappa gets under it
50 off 24 for KP, pushed down to long-off. He might just be the No. 3 Bangalore are looking for
lovely shot, walks across the stumps, and flicks it from outside off, past midwicket, lovely balance when he plays that imbalanced shot
back of a length, swatted down to long-on
slower ball, too full to get a false shot out of him, and the slice gets him two
appeal for lbw, hit outside the line, and Uthappa also shows his bat. Stays low too
there is only flight, no dip, and this half-volley has been crashed over extra cover. No "well bowled, Warney" chants here
gets the length to cut, but finds cover-point
paddled fine for a single
"Well bowled Warney," says Ojha. Uthappa has other ideas, he has just danced down the track and smashed him over long-on
turn there, punched away to straight extra cover
short, turning away, cut away in front of square, past extra cover for two
slower ball, on the pads, flicked away to deep midwicket for one
full ball, pushed on the walk, straight extra cover dives and parries it wide of long-off, and allows them comes back for two
slower bouncer, beats him on the pull
back of a length, looks to run it down to third man, but misses
full ball, lines up to go big and straight, but it is a slower one and beats him
full and wide, dragged to mid-on
slower ball, pushed down the ground for one
playing at will here, walks across and drags this from outside off, and flicks it over midwicket
clipped away off the pads, a mere tickle and it has the deep square leg diving
slower ball, tickled away for one to on
legcutter, Uthappa gets too far across, misses, is hit on the back thigh, but not given. Replays suggest it would have kissed the top of middle
back of a length, slapped through covers on the up, gets a single
short ball, and Uthappa pulls it to the cow corner. Good over for that net run-rate
makes room, looks to go over mid-on, but there is no spin on it, and gets an inside edge for one
charges at him, is not quite close to the pitch but still manages to hit it wide of mid-on
SLA? What SLA? moves way across and sweeps him over square leg
looks to cut this from in front of stumps, but it skids through, and gets the bottom edge that is safe
SLAs won't trouble him with wide half-trackers, he cuts it mercilessly for four
comes forward to push a length ball to mid-off

slower ball, looks to tap it into the on side, and he gets a leading edge towards extra cover, and Yusuf holds onto it, but his facial reaction conveys visibility problem. Eyes contracting as if in smoke
half-volley, outside off, and too easy, lofted over mid-off
slower one, looks to cut, but it is not short enough for the shot
Another Tight Slap! Back of a length, 125ks, walks down the track and swats it over midwicket
starts off with the slower one, played to short midwicket
is handcuffed as he looks to drive, no room, but he is safe
bouncing KP! Bouncing behind midwicket! Quick to transfer his weight and pull him over midwicket, no pace in Kamran to threaten KP
best shot of the lot, stays his ground, gets a back of a length delivery, and punches it on the up, between mid-off and extra cover
walks down the track again, converts this into a low full toss, and muscles it past mid-off

One Tight Slap! KP walks down the track, Kamran bowls short and wide, KP stretches all he can, with long arms and all, and is on one foot when he slaps it over cover. Balletic, says Jeremy Coney. Who is to argue with the Conster?
full toss, on the pads, hit to mid-on, misses out, but it's difficult to pick from Kamran's slingy action
full delivery outside off, left alone
back of a length, punched to mid-on for one
slower ball, checks the shot and defends it back
another one on the pads, and this time he flicks it in front of square, elegant shot, just giving it the direction, wide of mid-on
back of a length, around off, pushed back to the bowler
poor delivery, leg-side half-volley, and KP has flicked much better deliveries to square leg in his sleep
looks to upper-cut this but it bounces a bit extra and in the end he ends up fending awkwardly at it. Slow tennis-ball bounce on this one
driven wide of mid-off for an easy single
full outside off, driven straight to mid-off
played on! stays low and skids through as Kallis looks to cut it, the bottom edge cannons into the stumps
length ball outside off, tries the big drive, the ball stops at him, gets the toe end
gets swing first up, but swinging too far down the leg side
corrects the line and the length, around off, and short of driving length, hit to mid-off
leg-stump half-volley, and punished, wristy flick wide of mid-on
pitched up, hit to point with an open face, his weight wasn't stuck behind
pulled away in front of square again, keeps it down again, but can't get it past midwicket
short, pulled away in front of square, gets two runs
good legcutter to begin with, beats him outside off, but bounces in front of Ojha
